name: Implosion
description: Strikes at the exhausted energy of a target within %cast_range% tiles, dealing %dmg_per_cooldown% damage for every turn of cooldown it is carrying.
details: The same damage splashes onto enemies within %radius% tile.

upgrade.summary: Takes %free_attacks% free attacks on the target before the damage lands.
details: The same damage splashes onto enemies within %radius% tile.
The %free_attacks% attacks are made first, so whatever cooldowns they drive up - Energy Break's, above all - are counted by the implosion that follows.
